biography: Raphael Campos, a name whispered with both excitement and frustration in the VX Endurance paddock, hails from the sun-drenched favelas of Rio de Janeiro. Unlike many of his peers, Raphael's journey didn't begin on a karting track funded by a wealthy family. Instead, it started with dismantling and rebuilding discarded scooters with his grandfather, a retired mechanic. One sweltering afternoon, while delivering groceries, Raphael stumbled upon a local street race, mesmerized by the raw power and skill on display. He spent weeks convincing a local garage owner to let him work in exchange for track time in a beat-up kart. His raw talent quickly became apparent. Campos clawed his way through regional competitions, his aggressive driving style often resulting in spectacular overtakes and equally spectacular crashes. VX Endurance saw potential beneath the inconsistency and offered him a spot on their development team. Now, two years into his professional career, Raphael shows flashes of brilliance, punctuated by costly mistakes, leaving fans and critics alike unsure if he'll become a champion or a cautionary tale.
drivingStyle: Campos is a high-risk, high-reward driver. He attacks every corner as if it's the last, often pushing the limits of his tires and the car itself. While this aggressive approach can lead to breathtaking overtakes and blistering lap times, it also makes him prone to errors, especially under pressure. Tire management is often an afterthought, and his radio communication can be erratic, alternating between calm feedback and frustrated outbursts. Some call it passion, others call it recklessness; either way, it makes for compelling viewing.

rivalries.reason: Dubois, known for her calculated precision, has clashed with Campos multiple times after he made overly aggressive overtaking attempts, leading to on-track contact and heated exchanges in the media.
Tanaka, a veteran known for his unflappable demeanor, publicly criticized Campos's driving style after a particularly chaotic race, calling it 'dangerous and disrespectful.'

A fellow Brazilian, Viana represents the establishment Campos is fighting against, seen as the 'rich kid' who had everything handed to him. Their rivalry is fueled by national pride and contrasting backgrounds.

quirks: Always wears a faded bracelet his grandfather gave him before every race.
Refuses to look at the starting grid before the race, claiming it brings bad luck.
Listens to a specific samba song on repeat an hour before the race, no matter the genre he usually prefers.
famousQuote: Pressure? Pressure is not having food on the table. This is racing, it's a privilege.
careerHighlight: Qualifying on pole position at the Interlagos Grand Prix in his rookie year, a testament to his raw speed and fearlessness.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the Valencia Grand Prix due to a misjudged braking point, costing his team a crucial victory and leading to intense criticism.
